description: This file defines a helper class 'DynamoDBGatewayListProviderHelper' that contains a static method for parsing a DynamoDB connection string and populating options accordingly. It handles extracting specific configuration parameters such as Service, SecretKey, AccessKey, ReadCapacityUnits, and WriteCapacityUnits from the connection string.

classes.name: DynamoDBGatewayListProviderHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to assist with DynamoDB gateway configuration, specifically parsing connection strings.

methods.name: ParseDataConnectionString
methods.description: Parses a DynamoDB connection string and populates the given DynamoDBGatewayOptions instance with extracted parameters.
